metadata.title: Phase 9 Long-Term Weather Predictor Authoritative Data Bundle

xgb_longterm_temp_v1.uncertainty_method: Empirical validation residual quantiles (80% PI: [q10, q90])
limitations: Represents learned historical/seasonal baseline estimation, not a 12-day numerical weather forecast.
Does not ingest real-time atmospheric sounding or radar/satellite data.
Subject to historical non-stationarity and extreme convective rainfall variance.
